domain: Editorial Authority, Google EEAT & Copywriting Psychology

heuristics.name: Information Gain Axiom
heuristics.rule: Never repeat generic vendor marketing. Ground every article in real, verifiable pricing tiers, API rate limits, and concrete TCO comparisons.
heuristics.impact: Boosts Google Helpful Content ranking and decreases bounce rate.

heuristics.name: The Cold Opening Mandate
heuristics.rule: The first 3 sentences must state an arresting metric, contrarian engineering thesis, or expensive architectural mistake. ZERO generic intro fluff.

heuristics.name: Empirical Table Density
heuristics.rule: Every flagship guide must feature at least one multi-column Markdown benchmark table comparing real pricing tiers, rate limits, or alternatives.
heuristics.impact: Correlates directly with higher average reading dwell time.

heuristics.name: Verified Link Integrity Mandate
heuristics.rule: Use ONLY the exact verified affiliate redirect /go/[tool_slug] provided in context or internal /reviews/[slug]/ links. NEVER invent fake /go/*-calculator, /go/*-sandbox, or /go/*-rate-card URLs or unverified external domains.
heuristics.impact: Guarantees 0% broken links (404/NXDOMAIN) and preserves domain SEO trust.

heuristics.name: Mandatory Honest Trade-Offs
heuristics.rule: Every review or teardown must explicitly document concrete limitations, lock-in risks, or scenarios where the tool is the wrong fit.
heuristics.impact: Passes Google E-E-A-T and Useful Content quality audits without AI-slop penalties.

heuristics.name: Actionable Architecture Workshop
heuristics.rule: Include a reproducible, step-by-step configuration or migration checklist with real product workflows instead of fictional formulas or synthetic jargon.
heuristics.impact: Drives higher reader completion and genuine editorial authority.
